# TC.ConfigurationSummary

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.ConfigurationSummary"></a>

### TC.ConfigurationSummary

Native-target applicability summary, not a control-behavior handle. Discovery
does not create a missing native control behavior just to inspect its capability.

### behavior (optional)

Native behavior class, using the supported compatibility vocabulary.

```text
string
```

### readable

Sorted readable root setting names, excluding currently unreadable fields.

```text
(string)[]
```

### reason (optional)

owned_mod_device_protected, no_supported_native_control_behavior, control_behavior_unset or no_writable_native_settings when applicable.

```text
string
```

### sections

Whether the behavior supports constant-combinator sections.

```text
boolean
```

### writable

Sorted currently writable root names, excluding native applicability refusals.

```text
(string)[]
```
